### This Shunammite Leaves Gospel Footprints
Author: Erik Raymond
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/erik-raymond/this-shunammite-leaves-gospel-footprints/
Passage: 2 Kings 8:1-6
Points:
- The Shunammite returned home empty-handed and appealed to the king for grace to reclaim her property.
- God orchestrated the timing so the king was hearing of her revived son at the exact moment she entered.
- Moved by Elisha's work on her behalf, the king restored her estate along with all its lost income.
- Her story foreshadows the gospel, showing how helpless sinners receive unmerited favor before the King.
- Through Christ's finished work, believers are credited with righteousness and receive a reward they did not earn.
- Experiencing such boundless mercy calls believers to walk forward with deep gratitude and praise.
